name: Indian Potato-Cauliflower Curry (Aloo Gobi) with Cucumber Raita & Naan

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 medium yellow potatoes
3 tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Cut leaves off each cauliflower head, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, onion, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and small dice potatoes; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Add spices to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cauliflower, potato, tomato, and broth to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 18-20 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the curry cooks, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in the reserved bowl (reserving the rest for the curry).
Trim and grate cucumbers into the bowl with the cilantro; add yogurt, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the raita and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.

Divide naan between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping once, until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven, spread with oil, and cut into quarters.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 flatbreads or naan
1 ½ tsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: When the curry is done, stir in reserved cilantro and remove from the heat.
Divide curry between bowls; serve with raita and naan on the side. Enjoy!
